settings.name_in_paper: Personalized federated X-armed bandit (local cumulative regret)
unmapped: M clients each with its own heterogeneous local objective f_m on a shared domain X; regret is the sum over clients of local regrets (personalized)
Objectives satisfy only weak local smoothness w.r.t. a dissimilarity function and a hierarchical partition (Assumption 2), not standard Lipschitzness
Difference in optimal values |f_bar^* - f_m^*| <= Delta (Assumption 3); the learner knows Delta
The learner knows the smoothness constants nu_1 and rho and the hierarchical partition
Communication only via a central server sharing summary statistics
settings.definition_quote: we assume that in total $M\in \mathbb{N}$ clients want to collaboratively solve their problems, and thus $M$ \textit{local objectives} are available, denoted by $\{f_m\}_{m=1}^M$, all defined on the same space $\mathcal{X}$ and bounded by $[0, 1]$. ... observes a noisy feedback $r_{m,t} \in [0, 1]$ defined as $ r_{m, t}:= f_m(x_{m, t}) + \epsilon_{m,t}$ ... R(T) = \sum_{t=1}^T \sum_{m=1}^M f_m^*  - \sum_{t=1}^T \sum_{m=1}^M f_m(x_{m,t})

symbols.d_bar: near-optimality dimension of the global objective f_bar (with eps_h = 6 nu rho^h)
symbols.d_max: maximum over clients of local near-optimality dimensions d_m (with eps_h = 12 nu rho^h)

conditions: all local objectives and the global objective satisfy local smoothness (Assumption 2)

source.label: thm: regret_upper_bound
source.quote: Suppose that all the local objectives $f_1, f_2 \cdots, f_M$ and the global objective $\overline{f}$ all satisfy Assumptions 2, 3. Setting $\delta = 1/M$ in Algorithm ..., the expected cumulative regret of the \texttt{PF-PNE} algorithm satisfies \mathbb{E}[R (T)] = \widetilde{\mathcal{O}} \left( M^\frac{\overline{d} + 1}{\overline{d} + 2} T^\frac{\overline{d}  + 1}{\overline{d} + 2} + M T^\frac{{d}_{\max}  + 1}{{d}_{\max}  + 2}\right) The number of communication rounds ... scales as $\min\{C_1 M \log \frac{1}{\Delta},  C_2(M \log MT) \}$

results.notes: Regret is sum over clients of f_m^* - f_m(x_{m,t}) in expectation, i.e. pseudo-regret. Paper's M mapped to N. Communication-round bound recorded separately.

source.label: thm: regret_upper_bound
source.quote: The number of communication rounds of \texttt{PF-PNE} scales as $\min\{C_1 M \log \frac{1}{\Delta},  C_2(M \log MT) \}$, where $C_1$, $C_2$ are two absolute constants.

results.notes: Number of communication rounds (not a regret); probability type not stated, deterministic by design.

symbols.d_min: minimum over clients of local near-optimality dimensions d_m

conditions: all local objectives and the global objective satisfy local smoothness (Assumption 2)

source.label: corollary: regret_upper_bound
source.quote: Suppose that all the assumptions in Theorem 3.1 and Assumption 4 are satisfied, and $d_{\text{new}}$ is the optimality-difference dimension as in Definition 2. Assume that $\Delta \leq C_3 (\log MT / T)^{\frac{1}{\max\{d_{\min}, d_{\text{new}}\}+2}}$, where $C_3$ is an absolute constant, the expected cumulative regret of the \texttt{PF-PNE} algorithm satisfies \mathbb{E}[R (T)] =\widetilde{\mathcal{O}} \left( M^\frac{d_{\min}  + 1}{d_{\min}   + 2} T^\frac{d_{\min}   + 1}{d_{\min} + 2} + M T^\frac{d_{\text{new}}  + 1}{d_{\text{new}}  + 2}\right)

results.notes: Delta here is the similarity bound of Assumption 3, not a gap; renamed Delta_sim.
